title: feat: list account quests through MCP
author: Circuit-Overtime
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a read-only `listQuests` MCP tool using the existing `/account/quests` gateway endpoint.
- Passes the API response through unchanged.
- Keeps the tool in the existing account service with no new abstraction.
- Documents and smoke-tests tool registration.

Requires an API key with `account:usage`; claiming remains dashboard-only.

Co-authored-by: Circuit-Overtime <74301576+Circuit-Overtime@users.noreply.github.com>

gist.headline: Quests enter the tool shed
gist.blurb: MCP agents can now check an account’s available Quests without leaving their little terminal garden. Claiming still lives in the dashboard; someone has to keep the prize counter staffed.
gist.summary: Added a read-only `listQuests` MCP tool that returns the existing `/account/quests` gateway response unchanged for API keys with the `account:usage` permission.
gist.impact: Agents using the Pollinations MCP server can now inspect available account Quests programmatically, while Quest claiming remains dashboard-only.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a quest-guide bee in a cozy garden-tool shed, showing the eager CRT Monitor Robot a parchment-like Quest list on a retro terminal. The terminal represents the new read-only MCP tool, while a small dashboard kiosk in the background holds the claim stamps to show that claiming remains separate; surround the scene with code-plants and tiny quest flowers.
